_meta.status: ZIP -> baseline territory via CEC climate zone (proxy). CA IOUs.
_meta.backbone: data/climate/zip_to_zone.json (CEC Building Climate Zone by ZIP)
_meta.note: No public ZIP->territory dataset exists; territories are climate-defined and we key off the authoritative CEC zone. Rates are territory-invariant; only the baseline allowance (kWh/day tier threshold) changes. See per-utility confidence.

14328.method: CEC climate zone -> PG&E territory, matched by climate character and verified against harvested per-territory baselines. PG&E territories are defined by county/elevation, not ZIP; treat as a proxy. Unmapped zones -> representative.

16609.method: SDG&E defines Coastal/Inland/Mountain/Desert ON the CEC climate-zone boundaries (its inland boundary follows CEC CZ7). Direct CEC-zone map.

17609.method: SCE's TOU default (TOU-D-4-9PM) is a FLAT rate with no baseline tier, so no territory crosswalk is needed. (Only SCE's legacy tiered Domestic plan is region-split — deferred with the tiered legacy plans.)
